image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a light-colored wooden bookcase filled with books and media cases. The bookcase features multiple horizontal shelves. The left section contains rows of what appear to be CD or DVD cases with colorful spines. The right section holds hardcover and paperback books, some stacked horizontally. A small white electronic device (possibly a baby monitor or camera) sits on one of the right-hand shelves. The wood grain is visible, and the lighting appears natural, casting soft shadows.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the spines of the books and media cases is illegible and distorted. While some blurring is expected due to depth of field and resolution, many spines show 'melted' or nonsensical character shapes typical of AI generation failing to render fine print accurately.

The bottom-most visible shelf on the left side appears to tilt downward unnaturally, and the vertical support seems to merge ambiguously with the floor or lower structure. The geometry lacks rigid orthogonality expected in carpentry.

artifact_observations.location: White electronic device on the right shelf
artifact_observations.reasoning: The object resembles a baby monitor or camera but lacks defined buttons, lenses, or seams. It has a 'smoothed' plastic look with ambiguous features, suggesting AI hallucination of a complex object.
The vertical divider between the left and right sections appears to warp slightly near the top, not maintaining a perfectly straight line relative to the other vertical elements.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the book spines. In real photos, even blurry text retains linear structure. In AI images, it often becomes wavy or melts. Also, inspect the bottom-left corner for structural plausibility—does the shelf actually rest on a solid base? Check if the white device has any functional details (lens, buttons) or if it's just a smooth blob.
